no-restricted-syntax.message: Server Actions must RETURN expected failures: `return fail("...")` from @/lib/action-result. Next strips the message off anything thrown in a production build, so a throw works in dev and shows users a generic error once deployed. Re-raising a caught fault with `throw err` is still allowed.
Don't construct an Error in a Server Action — even one thrown indirectly loses its message in a production build. Return `fail("...")` from @/lib/action-result instead.
